request: Serving a reusable ProblemError value through the RFC 9457 problem-details error handler must not modify that value: after a request its fields are exactly what they were before.

defects.description: Published bug fixed upstream: fix(rfc9457): do not mutate a shared ProblemError (#3094)

trigger.input:
printf %s '' | base64 -d > rfc9457_test.go
if go test -count=1 -run '^(TestProblemDetailsHTTPErrorHandler_DoesNotMutateSharedProblem)$' . >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo probe: pass; else echo probe: fail; fi

defects.why_missed: The project's own suite at the parent commit never exercised this input; the fix commit added the test that does.
